description: North-Central Provincial Council - Notify the Orders pertaining to the business of Pawn broking w.e.f. 01.01.2018
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to the implementation of a provincial statute (Pawn Brokers Statute No. 3 of 2017) and establishes specific regulatory requirements for pawn broking businesses, including registration fees, license fees, security deposits, interest rates, and identification procedures. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it involves the enforcement and operational details of existing legislation rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
